title: 第1章 见诡第2章 回村第3章 替身
content_zh:
：我叫阿南，今年二十六岁。
在上大学的时候谈过一个女朋友叫刘倩倩，后来不知道为啥稀里糊涂的就分手了，就在昨天半夜我正准备睡觉的时候，刘倩倩给我发来一照片。
那是一张刘倩倩刚洗完澡，半裸的照片，看到这喷火的身材我猛地从床上坐了起来，一瞬间睡意全无。
紧接着刘倩倩又给我发了句，想吗？
我忙回复，想，想。
刘倩倩发了个地址，鬼魅酒吧，303包厢。
后面还配着一个挑逗的表情。
我当即精虫上脑，脑子里除了刘倩倩那白花花的身材，就什么都没有了。
到地方的时候，已经是午夜十二点了，头顶上方的鬼魅二字闪着诡异的红光。
我径直走进酒吧，往303包厢走去，到地方我轻轻敲了几下门，门打开，刘倩倩穿着一身红色浴袍，身材外露，性感妩媚的朝我走来。
刘倩倩用手着我的下巴道：“你怎么才来，想死人家了。”
“小宝贝，我来了。”
我抱起刘倩倩的细腰走进了包厢，刘倩倩也很配合的靠近在我身上，随着她呼吸的加速，我整个人都快充血爆炸了。
我直接把刘倩倩推倒了，可刚碰到她，就浑身打了个冷战。
刘倩倩的身体异常的冰冷，好像没有一丝温度。
而且她整个人干涩的很，像是一块已经风干了很久的老肉，瞬间意识到了不对劲。
刘倩倩则一脸荡.漾的叫道：“老公......”
还没等我缓过神，刘倩倩猛的一个翻身把我压在了身下，她双手拨弄着头发，妩媚至极。
随着刘倩倩迷离的样子，我意识逐渐昏沉，隐约中竟然发现，眼前的她居然变成了一具恐怖的干尸。
我一瞬间惊醒过来，大喊救命。

“有鬼啊，有鬼啊，走开，别碰我。”
我极力挣脱，想要逃走，却被那具干尸死死的按着我的双手，它冲着我吐了一口黑气，我瞬间眼前一黑，就晕死了过去。
我不知道是什么时候醒来的，只是醒来之后身体疼的要死。
“这到底怎么回事？”
我小声喃喃道。
可是当我抬起头看到眼前的景象的时候，瞬间汗毛直立，后脊背发凉，这里哪有什么酒吧，就是个乱葬岗子，满地的尸骨，无数坟包上面都插着一个招魂幡，就跟个吊死鬼一样在随风飘动。
而我此时正跪在一个墓碑前，上面写着刘倩倩之墓。
看到刘倩倩的名字的时候，我的心瞬间就提到了嗓子眼，下意识的摸到了脖子上的吊坠，这个吊坠是当年谈恋爱的时候送我的，说是她家的传家之宝，后来没缘由的分手后，我们就再没联系了，这难道是刘倩倩想给我指示点什么？
就在我腹诽疑惑时候，我看到刘倩倩的遗像赫然在冲着我笑，紧接着她的眼睛还流出两行血泪，原本还算祥和的遗照，瞬间成了一个恶鬼的模样。
“鬼啊。”
我吓得魂飞九天，大喊着有鬼，起身便跑。
可是无论我怎么跑都会回到原处，就在我弯下腰休息的时候，突然间刮起阵阵阴风，把地上白的黄的纸钱都给卷起在半空中。
我被风吹的睁不开眼，突然感到脸上黏黏的，像是被粘了什么东西一样。
说来也怪，我把粘在我脸上的东西拿下来，这风就停了。
content_en:
: My name is Anan, I am twenty-six years old.
When I was in college, I had a girlfriend named Liu Qianqian, but later we broke up for some reason. Just when I was getting ready to go to bed in the middle of the night last night, Liu Qianqian sent me a photo.
It was a photo of Liu Qianqian who had just taken a shower and was half-naked. Seeing this fiery figure, I sat up from the bed suddenly and lost all sleep in an instant.
Then Liu Qianqian sent me another sentence, Do you want it?
I was busy replying, thinking, thinking.
Liu Qianqian sent an address, Ghost Bar, Box 303.
There is also a provocative expression behind it.
My semen immediately came to my mind, and there was nothing in my mind except Liu Qianqian's white figure.
When we arrived at the place, it was already midnight, and the word ghost above our head was shining with a strange red light.
I walked straight into the bar and walked to box 303. When I got there, I knocked on the door a few times. The door opened and Liu Qianqian was wearing a red bathrobe, with her figure exposed and walking towards me sexy and charming.
Liu Qianqian held my chin with her hand and said, "Why did you come here? You miss me so much."
"Baby, here I come."
I picked up Liu Qianqian's slender waist and walked into the box. Liu Qianqian also cooperated and moved close to me. As her breathing accelerated, my whole body was about to explode with blood.
I pushed Liu Qianqian down directly, but as soon as I touched her, I shivered all over.
Liu Qianqian's body was unusually cold, as if there was no warmth at all.
Moreover, her whole body was very dry, like a piece of old meat that had been dried for a long time, and she instantly realized something was wrong.
Liu Qianqian shouted with excitement on her face: "Husband..."
Before I could calm down, Liu Qianqian suddenly turned over and pressed me down. She was playing with her hair with both hands, looking extremely charming.
Following Liu Qianqian's confused appearance, my consciousness gradually became faint, and I vaguely realized that she had turned into a terrifying mummy in front of me.
I woke up in an instant and shouted for help.
"There's a ghost, there's a ghost, go away, don't touch me."
I tried my best to break free and wanted to escape, but the mummy held my hands tightly. It breathed black breath at me, and my vision suddenly went black, and I fainted.
I don’t know when I woke up, but my body hurt like hell after I woke up.
"What the hell is going on?"
I murmured quietly.
But when I raised my head and saw the scene in front of me, the hairs on my hair stood up instantly, and my back felt chilly. There was no bar here, it was just a mass grave, with bones all over the ground, and countless graves with a soul-calling flag stuck on them, fluttering in the wind like a hanged ghost.
At this time, I was kneeling in front of a tombstone with the words "Liu Qianqian's tomb" written on it.
When I saw Liu Qianqian's name, my heart immediately rose to my throat, and I subconsciously touched the pendant around my neck. This pendant was given to me when we were in love, and it was said to be an heirloom of her family. After we broke up for no reason, we lost contact. Could it be that Liu Qianqian wanted to give me some instructions?
Just when I was fuming and confused, I saw Liu Qianqian's portrait smiling at me, and then two lines of blood and tears flowed from her eyes. The originally peaceful portrait suddenly turned into the appearance of an evil ghost.
"Ghost."
I was so frightened that I screamed that there was a ghost, got up and ran away.
But no matter how I ran, I would always come back to where I was. Just when I bent down to rest, a sudden gust of wind blew up, and all the white and yellow paper money on the ground was rolled up in the air.
I was so blown by the wind that I couldn't open my eyes, and suddenly I felt sticky on my face, as if something was stuck to it.
Oddly enough, when I took off the thing stuck to my face, the wind stopped.
